description: This file contains exported functions for interacting with organization-related API endpoints, including listing organizations and retrieving organization summaries. It includes asynchronous functions that fetch data from specific API endpoints, normalize and process data, and handle errors.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches and returns a sorted list of organizations (tenants) accessible to the current user by calling the GET /session/tenants API endpoint, normalizing data, and sorting by name and ID.

methods.name: getOrganizationSummary(tenantId)
methods.description: Builds a summary object for a specific tenant, including ID, name, total cost derived from user data, and user count. It fetches additional navigation data for tenant name if needed and handles data normalization and error cases.
